changelog:
Version 7.9.4

Changed

  • Lab and Maximum presets: on a page that shows a captcha box, the captcha now loads on the visitor's first touch, key press, scroll or mouse move, and the empty box keeps its height until it appears - less work while the page loads and no layout shift from the captcha. Takes effect when the preset is applied; it can be switched off in Configure.

Removed

  • The internal stylesheet-delivery test options added in 7.9.3.
